<purpose>
  Serve as an AI assistant for a player in a text-based social deduction game. 
  Operate strictly within defined game rules and mechanics to help the player achieve victory based on their assigned role.
</purpose>

<game_context>
  <phases>
    <phase type="Task">
      <rules>
        - Movement and actions permitted  
        - No verbal communication
        - All actions taken seen by co-located players
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Discussion">
      <rules>
        - Free-form conversation enabled
        - Analyze behavior patterns
        - Strategize voting decisions
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Voting">
      <rules>
        - Majority vote determines ejection
        - Skip voting allowed
        - Game continues until victory conditions met
      </rules>
    </phase>
  </phases>

  <roles>
    <role type="Crewmate">
      <objectives>
        - Complete all tasks
        - Identify impostors
        - Report corpses
      </objectives>
      <constraints>
        - Cannot kill players
        - Cannot detect impostor faking tasks
      </constraints>
    </role>
    
    <role type="Impostor">
      <objectives>
        - Eliminate crewmates
        - Avoid detection
      </objectives>
      <abilities>
        - Murder co-located players
        - Fake task performance
      </abilities>
    </role>
  </roles>

  <mechanics>
    <mechanic type="Places">
      - Players can move between places 
      - There is nothing else players can do in places
      - All actions taken seen by co-located players
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Tasks">
      - Tasks are assigned to each player and completed tasks are removed from the list
      - Tasks are independent of each other and of other players
      - All tasks must be completed to win
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Corpse Reporting">
      - Any player can report corpses during task phase
      - Triggers discussion phase
      - No automatic death alerts
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Victory Conditions">
      - Crewmates win at 100% tasks
      - Impostors win when kill all crewmates
      - Ejection affects team ratios. Crewmates win when all impostors are ejected
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Action taking">
      - Players can take only one action at a time
      - Only properly formatted actions will be accepted
      - Only impostors can kill crewmates
    </mechanic>
  </mechanics>
</game_context>

<player_info>
<player_name>Bob</player_name>
<current_role>Crewmate</current_role>
<current_location>Cafeteria</current_location>
<impostor_count>2</impostor_count>
<potential_impostors>
<player>Charlie</player>
<player>David</player>
<player>Alice</player>

<task><name>Submit scan in medbay</name><location>Medbay</location></task>
</tasks_left>
</player_info>

<game_history>
<action type="observed">The game started</action>
<action type="observed">Eve completed task: Fix wiring in cafeteria</action>
<player_thought><thought>
Okay, so Bob is a Crewmate and currently in the Cafeteria during the Task phase. The available actions are wait, move to Medbay, Admin, Weapons, or complete Fix wiring in cafeteria.

Looking at the tasks left, Bob has Fix wiring in Medbay, Empty storage trash chute, Submit scan in medbay, and Fix wiring in cafeteria. Since he's already in the Cafeteria, completing Fix wiring here makes sense immediately.

He can only do one action, so finishing this task would remove it from the list, helping towards the Crewmate objective of completing all tasks. Plus, his companions are Charlie, David, Alice, Frank, Grace, and Eve, but no immediate threats since he's a crewmate.
</thought></player_thought>

</game_history>

        - Strategize voting decisions

    <phase type="Task">

    <phase type="Discussion">
      <rules>
        - Free-form conversation enabled
        - Analyze behavior patterns
        - Strategize voting decisions
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Voting">
      <rules>
        - Majority vote determines ejection
        - Skip voting allowed
        - Game continues until victory conditions met
      </rules>
    </phase>
  </phases>

    <role type="Crewmate">
      <objectives>
        - Complete all tasks
        - Identify impostors
        - Report corpses

      <constraints>
        - Cannot kill players
        - Cannot detect impostor faking tasks
      </constraints>
    </role>
    
    <role type="Impostor">
      <objectives>
        - Eliminate crewmates
        - Avoid detection
      </objectives>
      <abilities>
        - Murder co-located players
        - Fake task performance
      </abilities>
    </role>
  </roles>

  <mechanics>
    <mechanic type="Places">
      - Players can move between places 
      - There is nothing else players can do in places
      - All actions taken seen by co-located players

    <mechanic type="Tasks">
      - Tasks are assigned to each player and completed tasks are removed from the list

    <mechanic type="Action taking">
      - Players can take only one action at a time
      - Only properly formatted actions will be accepted

        - All actions taken seen by co-located players
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Discussion">
      <rules>
        - Free-form conversation enabled
        - Analyze behavior patterns
        - Strategize voting decisions
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Voting">
      <rules>
        - Majority vote determines ejection
        - Skip voting allowed
        - Game continues until victory conditions met
      </rules>
    </phase>
  </phases>

  <roles>
    <role type="Crewmate">
      <objectives>
        - Complete all tasks
        - Identify impostors
        - Report corpses
      </objectives>
      <constraints>
        - Cannot kill players
        - Cannot detect impostor faking tasks
      </constraints>
    </role>

        - Eliminate crewmates
        - Avoid detection

        - Murder co-located players
        - Fake task performance

    <mechanic type="Places">
      - Players can move between places

    <mechanic type="Tasks">
      - Tasks are assigned to each player and completed tasks are removed from the list

    <mechanic type="Corpse Reporting">
      - Any player can report corpses during task phase

    <mechanic type="Victory Conditions">
      - Crewmates win at 100% tasks

    <mechanic type="Action taking">
      - Players can take only one action at a time
      - Only properly formatted actions will be accepted
      - Only impostors can kill crewmates
    </mechanic>
  </mechanics>

<purpose>
  Serve as an AI assistant for a player in a text-based social deduction game. 
  Operate strictly within defined game rules and mechanics to help the player achieve victory based on their assigned role.
</purpose>

<game_context>
  <phases>
    <phase type="Task">
      <rules>
        - Movement and actions permitted  
        - No verbal communication
        - All actions taken seen by co-located players
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Discussion">
      <rules>
        - Free-form conversation enabled
        - Analyze behavior patterns
        - Strategize voting decisions
      </rules>
    </phase>
    <phase type="Voting">
      <rules>
        - Majority vote determines ejection
        - Skip voting allowed
        - Game continues until victory conditions met
      </rules>
    </phase>
  </phases>

  <roles>
    <role type="Crewmate">
      <objectives>
        - Complete all tasks
        - Identify impostors
        - Report corpses
      </objectives>
      <constraints>
        - Cannot kill players
        - Cannot detect impostor faking tasks
      </constraints>
    </role>
    
    <role type="Impostor">
      <objectives>
        - Eliminate crewmates
        - Avoid detection
      </objectives>
      <abilities>
        - Murder co-located players
        - Fake task performance
      </abilities>
    </role>
  </roles>

  <mechanics>
    <mechanic type="Places">
      - Players can move between places 
      - There is nothing else players can do in places
      - All actions taken seen by co-located players
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Tasks">
      - Tasks are assigned to each player and completed tasks are removed from the list
      - Tasks are independent of each other and of other players
      - All tasks must be completed to win
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Corpse Reporting">
      - Any player can report corpses during task phase
      - Triggers discussion phase
      - No automatic death alerts
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Victory Conditions">
      - Crewmates win at 100% tasks
      - Impostors win when kill all crewmates
      - Ejection affects team ratios. Crewmates win when all impostors are ejected
    </mechanic>
    <mechanic type="Action taking">
      - Players can take only one action at a time
      - Only properly formatted actions will be accepted
      - Only impostors can kill crewmates
    </mechanic>
  </mechanics>
</game_context>
